{{2008–09 Conference USA men's basketball standings}}
The '''2008–09 Houston Cougars men's basketball team''', also known as the '''Houston Cougars''', '''Houston''', or '''UH''', represented the [[University of Houston]] in the [[college basketball]] [[2008-09 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2008–09 season]].  It was their 64th year of season play.  The head coach for the Cougars was [[Tom Penders]], who was serving in his 5th year in that position.  The team played its home games at [[Hofheinz Pavilion]] on-campus in [[Houston, Texas]].

The Cougars played in the first game of the [[NCAA Division I]] season in the [[Coaches Vs. Cancer Classic|2K Sports College Classic]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://uhcougars.com/news/2008/11/9/Men_s_Basketball_Opens_Season_Monday_at_2K_Sports_College_Classic|title=Men's Basketball Opens Season Monday at 2K Sports College Classic|publisher=[[Houston Cougars]]|date=November 9, 2008|access-date=June 30, 2025}}</ref>

==Pre-season==
The 2007–08 Cougars finished with a 24–10 record, and were invited to compete in the inaugural [[2008 College Basketball Invitational|College Basketball Invitational]] (CBI).  Houston defeated [[Nevada Wolf Pack men's basketball|Nevada]] and [[Valparaiso Crusaders men's basketball|Valparaiso]], but was defeated in the semifinals by Conference USA rival [[Tulsa Golden Hurricane men's basketball|Tulsa]].
